from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u056/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-0f8da700.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    inset = 1
    while bottom - top + 1 - 2 * inset > 3 and right - left + 1 - 2 * inset > 3:
        color = 2 if inset % 2 == 1 else 5
        r1, r2 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c1, c2 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
            out[r1][c] = color
            out[r2][c] = color
        for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
            out[r][c1] = color
            out[r][c2] = color
        inset += 1
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform', program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Recreate demo input and its expected output.

for r in range(1,10): demo[r][1]=demo[r][9]=5
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]

for c in range(3,8): expected[3][c]=expected[7][c]=5
for r in range(3,8): expected[r][3]=expected[r][7]=5
print('demo matches:', mod.transform(demo)==expected)

test=[[0]*30 for _ in range(30)]
for c in range(1,26): test[1][c]=test[25][c]=5
for r in range(1,26): test[r][1]=test[r][25]=5
answer=mod.transform(test)
print('program:', program_path)

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    side = min(bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1)
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    inset = 1
    while side - 2 * inset > 0:
        ring_side = side - 2 * inset
        if side <= 9 and side % 2 == 1 and ring_side <= 3:
            break
        color = colors[(inset - 1) % len(colors)]
        r1, r2 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c1, c2 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
            out[r1][c] = color
            out[r2][c] = color
        for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
            out[r][c1] = color
            out[r][c2] = color
        inset += 1
    return out
'''
